Steven, welcome. Hello, this is Steven Huss. Thank you for having me as your audience for a discussion about athlete-centered coaching. This is something that I have aspired to do and first heard about it from Dr. Anthony Ross, who I worked with late in my tennis career and very early in my coaching career. And when he told me about it, I thought, right, that's what I want to do. I want to be athlete-centered. I'm going to do this.
